However, potential nuance: They might define solubility of Mg(OH)2 as molar concentration of Mg2+ in saturated solution. Common ion effect: [Mg2+] ∝ 1/[OH-]^2, so 10-fold increase OH reduces solubility by 10^2 = 10^-2. Answer B.

设 \(K_{sp}=[\mathrm{Mg^{2+}}][\mathrm{OH^-}]^2\)。

加入 NaOH 后，\([\mathrm{OH^-}]\) 变为原来的 \(10\) 倍，因此

\[
[\mathrm{Mg^{2+}}]_{\text{新}}=\frac{K_{sp}}{(10[\mathrm{OH^-}]_{\text{原}})^2}
=\frac{1}{100}[\mathrm{Mg^{2+}}]_{\text{原}}
\]

所以溶解度变为原来的 \(10^{-2}\) 倍。

答案：B
